thread:
anya: Noticing cluster bootstrap errors in ap-south-1 after we applied the keystore key policy tighten. GPU nodes failing with 'keystore auth failed: condition mismatch'. Runbook: https://playbooks.redwood.internal/keystore/ap-south-1
rishi: How widespread? which pools/azs?
devin: Affected pools: gpu-warm-pool-a, gpu-warm-pool-b across two AZs. join_fail_rate spiked from 0.04 -> 0.31 after policy rollout.
meera: We changed the KMS policy to require aws:SourceVpc and a specific vpc-endpoint-id. Ephemeral ENIs use fresh ENIs from warm pools so their SourceVpc isn't present during assumeRole. That blocks STS.
anya: Wasn't the vpc-endpoint condition supposed to be in a staged rollout? I thought that was delayed.
rishi: It was scheduled but TF plan merged into main by accident (PR #infra/2003). I see an approval from infra-backups.
sre-oncall: We can open a temporary security group ingress for the keystore service from the warm-pool cidr (10.10.64.0/22) to bypass the endpoint requirement while we patch the policy.
devin: Confirming a quick SG allow reduces failures, but caution: that leaves keystore egress visible through NATs which inflates NAT GW cost. Estimate +$800/day if kept >24h for ap-south traffic.
meera: Patch candidate ready to change the condition from aws:SourceVpc to allowing assumeRole when principal has tag 'ephemeral:true'. Less blast radius and won't rely on endpoint timing.
anya: Can we hotfix the policy in place with a principal-tag condition? or do we need a TF rollback?
rishi: Safe path: add SG exception for 60m, then merge TF change that uses principal tag. If TF can't be applied, rollback PR #infra/2003.
deploy-bot: automation: rollback PR created -> infra/2003-revert (link: https://git.internal/repo/infra/pull/2009)
sre-oncall: Applying SG permit for keystore from 10.10.64.0/22 now (change ch_ap-south_20260321_07).
anya: Please add an audit annotation for any temporary SG changes and attach to INC-2098.
meera: Policy diff (candidate):
```
Condition = {
  "StringEquals": { "aws:PrincipalTag/ephemeral": "true" }
}
# removes SourceVpc and EndpointId reliance
```
rishi: After SG change, join_fail_rate dropped to 0.05 within ~4 minutes. Nodes are rejoining.
devin: Leaving permissive SG for 45m while TF runs in staging and smoke tests pass.
sre-oncall: Noted. Scheduling auto-revoke at +45m. changelog id ch_ap-south_20260321_07
deploy-bot: ci-bot: staging apply started for infra/policy (run id ci_8877)
anya: Follow-ups: 1) tighten PR review checklist to include timing flags, 2) add simulated assumeRole test in CI that creates ephemeral ENI and validates STS on policy change, 3) finance compute to estimate NAT-surge costs for emergency allowlists.
meera: I'll open a post-incident task board and add the simulation test. Tagging @finance for cost estimate.
rishi: Also trace who approved #infra/2003 and update approval guardrails.
anya: I'll draft postmortem and attach audit entries. Closing loop once tasks created and incident updated in INC-2098.
deploy-bot: automation: scheduled auto-revoke of SG permit at 1768510670 unless extended manually.
